name: sfx_sample_player
title: Unused 1-bit sample player on the CIA1 timer B IRQ, and its unused set-up

comments.text: Unreachable CIA1 timer B IRQ of a 1-bit sample player: CIA1 IRQs are off and nothing calls sfx_sample_start. Each IRQ toggles the SID volume between 0 and 15, then reads one sample byte through sfx_sample_ptr. The byte selects the timer B count to the next toggle from $0e00 (low) and $0f00 (high). Every raster handler jumps here on a non-VIC IRQ.
Raster IRQs can interrupt the sample IRQ
Toggle the volume 0 <-> 15: one click per IRQ
Count low byte; $0e00 now holds music driver code
Count high byte; $0f00 now holds music driver code
End of the sample: timer B stays stopped
Timer B: start, one-shot, load the latch, count timer A underflows

Unused set-up routine of the sample player: nothing calls it. It stops the CIA1 timers, sets sfx_sample_ptr = $0804 and sfx_sample_end = $0a04, clears the SID registers and sets sfx_volume = 15. Then it starts timer A (latch 8, continuous) and timer B (latch $0101, one-shot, counts timer A), with the timer B IRQ on.
